name: Giulia Ferraresi
headline: Product Designer | UX/UI & Design Systems
summary: Product designer with 5 years of experience crafting user-centered digital products for fintech and e-commerce companies. Skilled in translating user research into scalable design systems and intuitive interfaces. Passionate about collaborative design processes and data-informed decision making.

responsibilities: Lead end-to-end design of core banking app features from research to high-fidelity prototypes
Built and maintained a comprehensive design system used across three product teams
Conducted user interviews and usability tests to validate design decisions
Collaborated closely with engineers to ensure design feasibility and consistency
Designed wireframes and prototypes for e-commerce clients across web and mobile
Facilitated user research sessions and synthesized findings into actionable insights
Contributed to establishing initial design guidelines and component libraries
Partnered with product managers to prioritize features based on user needs
Assisted senior designers with wireframing and visual design tasks
Supported user research activities including surveys and moderated tests
Created basic UI mockups for internal tools and client projects
